text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, I lost! Everyone's going to start

smack-talking me again!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
They're always like, "You're too short to
do well
in races"... "You're not suited for
the turf"... Pisses
me off!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
They're always like, "You're too short to
do well
in races"... "You're not suited for
the turf"... Pisses
me off!
choice_data_list: 俺はタイシンの強さを信じてるぞ！
私はタイシンの強さを信じてるよ！
悔しさをバネにトレーニングだ！
悔しさをバネにトレーニングだよ！

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Oh, whatever! I don't need your pity!
choice_data_list: 俺はタイシンの強さを信じてるぞ！
私はタイシンの強さを信じてるよ！
悔しさをバネにトレーニングだ！
悔しさをバネにトレーニングだよ！

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
How can you be so sure of me when I
have
nothing to show for it?
choice_data_list: 同情じゃない！本当に信じてるんだ！
同情じゃない！本当に信じてるんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
All you say is that you believe in me
whenever I
lose.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I don't believe you when you
say that!

If she doesn't trust me, then I'll just have
to
explain everything until she does.
choice_data_list: じゃあその根拠を説明する！

text_block_list.text:
Her competitive spirit and relentless

determination, not to mention her final
sprint, are
her strengths. I'm expounding
on her acceptance
of and devotion to
overcoming her weaknesses,
when...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Stop! Geez, okay! I get it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to win next time just so I don't
have to
go through this again!

Somehow, Narita Taishin's mood has
improved.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sick and tired of being looked down
on all the
time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll blow past everyone and
take first
place!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm just annoyed that I got caught up in
your
dumb energy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
But, ugh... I guess I need you if I want to
win.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Beef up my training regimen—make it
tougher. If
you go easy on me, I'll end
you.

Although slightly displeased, Narita
Taishin feels
more determined than ever
to win her upcoming
race.
